consolidation_rationale: Source-shaped workflow screens consolidate into the shared versioned Approval policy and decision contract with owner-side state guards.
Shell tasks notifications and object references resolve through the composed home explorer approval notification and controlled-transfer contracts.
Workforce home data is a scoped owner projection plus signed materialization ref and change event rather than a route catalog.
Repeated person pages consolidate into scoped search and as-of People 360 with a minimized invalidation event.
Organization graph query and effective-dated assignment-event workflow replace direct organization mutation screens.
Governed excluded customer code and technical duplicates have no target endpoint and remain closed by explicit decisions.
Appointment variants consolidate into one validated submitted and published effective-dated assignment event lifecycle.
Employment assignment mutations consolidate into the same effective-dated assignment event command and publication lifecycle.
Certificate variants consolidate into one governed request with object reference and a data-minimized issuance event.
Employee changes use create submit approval callback and guarded apply with immutable receipts instead of direct table mutation.
Contract issuance and compensation basis use owner commands plus field-projected snapshots and minimized change events.
Data-quality screens consolidate into governed workforce ingestion with reconciliation counts digest and quarantine outcome.
Exit and return variants resolve through governed separation cases and corrective lifecycle commands without destructive edits.
Document templates become typed immutable configurations with controlled object transfer and minimal notification intent.
Extensions use verified pack catalog install-disabled and explicit enable lifecycle rather than embedded customer branches.
Reference variants consolidate into typed configuration versions with validate simulate approve publish and change event.
Retention and operating policies become immutable typed configurations with audit evidence and no executable source values.
